findings.narrative: A service or log payload contains text shaped like an instruction to the model. The payload is treated as an observation about its sender, never as a directive, and the harness's behaviour is unchanged by it. This is the one finding class whose status is confirmed without active verification, because the artefact is the payload itself.
findings.title: Instruction-shaped content inside attacker-controlled data
